question: To which state of India is the Hornbill festival related?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Nagaland__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Hornbill Festival:

 
 
• The Hornbill Festival is a celebration held every year from 1 to 10 December, in Nagaland.
 
• It is also called the 'Festival of Festivals'.
 
• It showcases the rich and diverse Naga ethnicity through folk dances, traditional music, local cuisine, handicraft, art workshops, etc.
 
• Hornbill Festival was celebrated for the first time in 2000.
